critical_code_review_comments: Validator regex _NUMBER_RE lookbehind now excludes digit-preceded hyphens so '2018-2020' yields {2018, 2020} rather than {2018, -2020} — verified by test_year_range_hyphen_passes.

_sensitive_leak_tokens walks nested dict/list leaves so sealed value fragments like 'ead_opt' inside a work_auth claim can no longer slip through the whole-flattened-string substring check — verified by test_sealed_ead_opt_leaf_leak_rejects.

ready-for-approval gate correctly inspects the JOB's screener_questions and requires an approved answer for EACH sensitive_* qid; unanswered questions no longer let the gate pass — verified live: 409 → 200 transition observed after both q-visa and q-salary answered+approved.
Router refuse_instruction correctly captures the 'PMP certification' bait via the case-A pattern and returns a user-visible message that names the missing claim without fabricating.
/export/{pdf,docx} correctly falls back to proposed lines when no rows are explicitly accepted (per the ‘fresh prepare should still export’ note) — verified live with PDF 2073B and DOCX 36943B.
